quest.title: The Missing Thing
quest.description: It turns out that the missing young detective was investigating a mysterious case on Watatsumi Island. According to him, something vital is missing on this island. What could it be?

chapter.num: Hangout Event: Shikanoin Heizou - Act I
chapter.title: Trap 'Em by Storm

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: #I apologize again for not being completely honest with you, {NICKNAME}. I truly am sorry, but... I had to do it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: By the way, does Kokomi know about all this?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Ah yes, Her Excellency... Well, let's just say that the war brought many terrible things while also forcing us to learn a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, but that still doesn't answer the question.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Well, ahem... aren't you curious about who's been pushing for the new commodity bill? It certainly isn't the Kanjou Commission, because it doesn't immediately benefit them, and we don't have any connections there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... it's kinda as if the gods suddenly appeared to offer you a divine hand.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Haha, yeah, the gods...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I was invited to attend the Irodori Festival on Narukami Island with Her Excellency a while back.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: At the festival, I waited in the marketplace while Her Excellency...

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: Todoroki, the shipment has arrived and is ready for inspection.

dialogues.speaker: Todoroki
dialogues.text: Good, let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it's Todo... mmph!

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Shh! Keep quiet. Let's follow him and see where he leads us.

talks.objective: Listen in on Todoroki and Tokuda's conversation

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: Your intel was spot on. When we arrived, the Nobushi were all still asleep, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: We captured them all, and the goods were retrieved and brought back here.

dialogues.speaker: Todoroki
dialogues.text: I'll take a look. Hmm... Everything seems in order, good work.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: It's nothing. Thanks to the efforts of your caravan, the price of grain in the village has decreased.

dialogues.speaker: Masashi
dialogues.text: That's right, and who would have thought that the injuries we sustained during the war would have such a lingering effect on our bodies. But thankfully, you also brought back some life-saving medicine.

dialogues.speaker: Todoroki
dialogues.text: Things are improving thanks to the help from those up top. By the way, what is the state of the village's inventory?

dialogues.speaker: Todoroki
dialogues.text: Make sure that it's confirmed tonight, I have to leave tomorrow morning after I go to the Sangonomiya Shrine and get instructions from General Gorou.

dialogues.speaker: Masashi
dialogues.text: Don't worry. We've already prepared the list. Just follow us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This box is packed so tight, it looks like it could burst. Let's see what's inside.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What are all these plants and flowers? Oh, there's a small note here.

dialogues.speaker: Torn Bill
dialogues.text: (A torn bill. The handwriting has been smudged by water stains, making it difficult to read. Only a faint outline of the words "Foreign Trade Association" can be seen at the signature.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Qingxin! Paimon was expecting to find Sango Pearls...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Glaze Lilies! What are these doing here? Shouldn't it be Crystal Marrow or something...

dialogues.speaker: Nanao
dialogues.text: Officer, don't forget to tell the officials how cooperative we've been! Please put in a good word for us!

talks.objective: Go with Heizou to where the inmates are imprisoned
Go to a nearby location and talk to Heizou

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Alright, let's see what we can come up with here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Went to see Lady Yae.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Yeah.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: She went to the Kanjou Commission to see Lady Yae — purportedly for a book review, but there were other items on the agenda, too. The meeting wasn't made public.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Following her return, we began our attempts at boosting commercial activity, and it wasn't long before there was a push for a new commodity bill on Narukami Island...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: So, what do you make of it? Do you think Her Excellency knows about this?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did she do...? I don't remember.
